title: Recent flight experience: Pilot in command

rules.title: General experience (carrying passengers, day)
rules.requirement: Within the preceding 90 days, performed 3 takeoffs and 3 landings as sole manipulator of the flight controls in an aircraft of the same category, class, and type (if a type rating is required).
rules.track_rule: Each detected (takeoff + landing) pair within 90 days counts as one event. Either touch_and_go or landed_full_stop satisfies the landing leg.
rules.notes: Currency is per-pilot; per-tail we can only track per-aircraft activity. Useful for displaying 'this aircraft made N currency-eligible legs in the last 90 days.'

rules.title: Tailwheel currency
rules.requirement: For tailwheel aircraft, the landings must be FULL-STOP (not touch-and-go).
rules.track_rule: Count only phaseML landed_full_stop events. touch_and_go does NOT satisfy tailwheel currency.

rules.title: Night experience (carrying passengers, night)
rules.requirement: Within the preceding 90 days, performed 3 takeoffs and 3 landings TO A FULL STOP at night.
rules.night_definition: FAR 1.1: from end of evening civil twilight to beginning of morning civil twilight, when sun is more than 6° below horizon. For 61.57(b) currency, FAA uses 1 hour after sunset to 1 hour before sunrise.
rules.track_rule: Detect takeoff and landed_full_stop events whose timestamp at the airport lat/lon falls in the night window. touch_and_go does NOT count.
rules.notes: Touch-and-go landings explicitly do NOT count for night currency — even though they count for day 61.57(a).

rules.title: Instrument experience
rules.requirement: Within the preceding 6 calendar months, in the appropriate category of aircraft for the instrument privileges sought, performed 6 instrument approaches, holding procedures and tasks, and intercepting and tracking courses through use of navigational electronic systems.
rules.track_rule: Approach detection requires inbound profile alignment with a known runway (descent to MAP / DA) — non-trivial from track alone. Defer to v2 (separate approaches.js module that reads CIFP/airport runway data).

rules.title: Flight review
rules.requirement: Within preceding 24 calendar months, a flight review consisting of 1 hour of flight training and 1 hour of ground training.
rules.track_rule: Cannot be inferred from tail's flight activity alone — flight review is performed in any aircraft and logged by the pilot.
